name: optcatalog_set_damage_context
description: OptCatalog::SetDamageContext stores the current damage-context kind and captures the candidate hit event only when it has a non-null hit node.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime context pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b28e0 validates the fastcall ABI, the null guard for the hit event pointer, the hitNode guard at offset 0x24, the conditional store to g_OptCatalog_DamageContextHitEvent, and the unconditional context-kind store.
The native smoke verifies null event and null hit-node inputs update only the kind, while a hit event with a non-null hit node is captured.
